subject: Solari launch: handoff deconflict & MAP timelines
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@solari.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@solari.io>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solari launch: handoff deconflict & MAP timelines

Hi Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the leadership team is aligned and wants to move to a staged pilot. Procurement and legal asked for a simple mutual action plan with milestones, responsibilities, and signoff dates so we can coordinate internal approvals and payroll for the pilot cohort.

A few asks from our side:
- Can you send a single spreadsheet MAP we can circulate with engineering and procurement?
- We need a clear owner for API onboarding and a named billing contact for the SOW/invoice.
- On our end procurement needs the SOW back for signature by Friday 6/27 if possible.

Attaching the SOW we received from Legal last night. I flagged a couple of minor redlines inline — nothing material but procurement likes to close clean.

Attachments: SOW-draft-Solari.pdf (received from Solari legal)

Lina Park
Director of Clinical Integrations
Solari Health
lina.park@solari.io
+1 415-555-0192
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@solari.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Solari launch: handoff deconflict & MAP timelines

Hi Lina — thanks, and great to hear leadership is greenlighting the pilot.

I put together a compact MAP and attached the spreadsheet below (MAP_Solari_2025-06-24.xlsx). High level timeline (proposed, all dates tentative until we lock SOW):

1) Kickoff + SOW signoff — target: 2025-06-27 (owner: Procurement / Jordan to coordinate signature flow)
2) API keys & environment access — 2025-06-30 (owner: Ben Carter, Infra)<
3) Integration window (ingest + smoke tests) — 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-10 (owner: Solari Eng / Ben as Redwood point)
4) Test cohort run & feedback loop — 2025-07-11 to 2025-07-24 (owner: Solari Product / Marissa for CS ops)
5) Training session + go/no-go review — 2025-07-25 (owner: Marissa)
6) Cutover to pilot SLA (soft production) — 2025-07-28 (owner: Solari Eng / Redwood on-call)

Key asks for you:
- Confirm billing contact (we'll populate SOW)
- Any blackout dates for July where Solari cannot accept cutover or testing (so we avoid scheduled maintenance windows)

I added column-level RACI in the spreadsheet and a risk column for “data mapping gaps” and “auth delays”. I also added an action row for DocuSign link once Legal confirms the final SOW.

Shared link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cD-Solari-MAP
Attachments: MAP_Solari_2025-06-24.xlsx

Onwards — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Park <lina.park@solari.io>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@solari.io>
Date: Tue, 24 Jun 2025 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Solari launch: handoff deconflict & MAP timelines

Thanks Jordan — spreadsheet is clear and a good starting point. I reviewed and added operational checkpoints and a compact acceptance rubric (see implementation-checkpoints.csv). A few operational notes inline here:

- Acceptance criteria: agree to a traffic/sample size for the pilot (I suggested 2k requests/day for the first week). Solari Product to confirm.
- Support model: Redwood will own runtime support during rollout; we need Solari's on-call schedule during the test window.
- Escalation path: add a daily 15-min stand during integration week (7/1-7/10) with engineering and CS. Owner: Marissa.
- Training: propose two 60-min sessions (admin + end-user) to be scheduled week of 7/14. Owner: Marissa.

I also flagged a procurement dependency: DocuSign signature for the SOW before any billing events. Jordan — can you confirm who at Redwood signs for commercial terms? Karthik — FYI on discount / credit asks from Solari leadership (they may request a pilot credit).

Attachments: implementation-checkpoints.csv

Subject: Re: Solari launch: handoff deconflict & MAP timelines

Jordan / Marissa — quick procurement note from my side.

We can sign the SOW by Friday 6/27 provided the commercial terms remain as discussed. A couple of constraints:
- We need an invoice and exact billing contact on the SOW to get internal approvals completed. Who should be listed as the Redwood billing contact?
- If Redwood is open to a small pilot credit (we discussed a nominal 10% for the 30-day pilot), that helps get final signoff from our CFO. Please let us know if that's something Karthik can confirm.
- Procurement will need the DocuSign link and a final SOW PDF (no comments) by EOD Thursday 6/26 to queue approvals.
